# CineStager

> CineStager is an augmented reality (AR) previsualization app for iPhone and iPad that lets filmmakers plan shots before the shoot day. Users import a scanned 3D model of a location, place it in AR at 1:1 scale, block scenes with adjustable mannequins, simulate camera bodies and lenses with accurate framelines, and export top-down shot maps to share with their crew.

CineStager is built by cinematographer Yannick Giraud and is free to download on the Apple App Store. Every feature is free for 7 days; after that a one-time purchase of €19.99 unlocks the app for good, with no subscription. It requires iOS 18.6 or later.

## What it does

- **Scan a location**: Import a 3D model scanned with a LiDAR app such as Polycam or Scaniverse, or any USDZ file (including models from Blender, SketchUp, or Unreal Engine).
- **Multi-storey locations**: Mark a building's floors once on import; a floor switch moves the location and mannequins between storeys.
- **Choose a camera and lens**: Pick from a library of camera bodies and sensor formats, configure prime or zoom lenses, set framelines, and save presets. Supported camera brands include ARRI, Sony, Canon, RED, Kodak, Blackmagic, and DJI.
- **Block the scene**: Place mannequins in various poses and adjust their height and position. Use occlusion mode to block real actors inside the virtual location.
- **Export**: Every image capture automatically saves a top-down map showing camera position and actor placement, ready to share with the gaffer, AD, and DP.
- **Two modes**: AR Mode places the scene in the real world; Game Mode lets you navigate a purely virtual environment.
- **Saved scenes**: Save a location with its mannequins as a scene and set it up again later, in AR or Game Mode.
- **iCloud sync**: Locations, scenes and shots sync between iPhone and iPad.

## Who it is for

Cinematographers, directors, and production crews doing previsualization for commercials, feature films, music videos, remote location scouting, and lens testing during prep.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad), iOS 18.6 or later
- Price: Free to download with a 7-day free trial of every feature, then a one-time purchase of €19.99 (or the local App Store equivalent); no subscription
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/cinestager/id6755585287
- Website: https://cinestager.com/
- Maker: Yannick Giraud (filmmaker)
